The error is generated when an upstream connection pool hits a circuit-breaker resource limit—most commonly pending requests, active requests/streams, or connections. Envoy maps `PoolFailureReason::Overflow` to `StreamResetReason::Overflow`, producing the reported reset and `UO` (`UpstreamOverflow`) response flag.
